results.title: Anesthesia
results.overview: A business executive meets his childhood mother in an anesthesia app, but is she there to help him?

results.title: Full Circle: The First All Black Everest Ascent
results.original_title: Full Circle: The First All Black Everest Ascent
results.overview: An all-Black team sets out to summit Mount Everest not just to make history, but to redefine what it means to climb and who belongs in the mountains.

results.title: Bruno - Der junge Kreisky
results.overview: Bruno Kreisky – Chancellor, statesman, reformer, global politician. No other Austrian politician has been the subject of so much writing and debate. How does one become someone like him? How does one become someone who can meet people of all views and social classes on equal footing? How does he navigate his way through life, love, and his convictions?

results.title: NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 7
results.overview: The seventh night of G1 Climax 36 took place on July 26, 2026, at EBARA WAVE Arena Ota in Tokyo, Japan, and was headlined by a B Block match between Gabe Kidd and Zack Sabre Jr.

results.title: Let's Love
results.overview: When a director, actor, screenwriter and actress reunite for the 10th Anniversary of their one-hit wonder film for a convention that suddenly gets cancelled, they must improvise and come up with ideas for a sequel while in rural Wales.

results.title: Surviving the Silence: The Roxane Gay Story
results.original_title: Surviving the Silence: The Roxane Gay Story
results.overview: When 12-year-old Roxane moves with her family to what appears to be the ideal suburban community, her life is forever changed after a devastating act of sexual violence. As she grapples with the lasting effects of that trauma, Roxane turns to food as a means of survival, beginning a lifelong journey to understand her body, reclaim her voice and confront a society that often defines women by their appearance.

results.title: Matador Bolero
results.overview: New York nightclub, The Matador, becomes the site of a high-profile murder that attracts the attention of an obsessive detective, a TV news reporter, and an elusive being living outside the realms of time and space. Their stories converge with that of a new-age cult operating at the command of an ultra-intelligent supercomputer named Bolero.

results.title: Night of the Vamp-Friars
results.overview: A group of friends in a punk rock band discover a hidden cemetery in the woods where they accidentally raise a group of undead Friars.

results.title: Halloween Bird
results.overview: On Halloween night, a deaf girl and her grandmother carve pumpkins and wait for trick-or-treaters. They are about to receive a menacing visitor.

results.title: The Trial of Alec Baldwin
results.overview: A provocative examination Alec Baldwin as he faces charges of manslaughter, with a cross-examination of the American legal system and the court of public opinion.

results.title: Sweetness
results.overview: When a chance encounter with her rockstar crush leads 16-year-old Rylee to discover that he's a dysfunctional drug addict, she takes it upon herself to help him, ultimately forcing her teenage fantasies into reality.

results.title: Spirit Board: Doorway to Death
results.overview: A group of bored friends play with a spirit board and accidentally conjure the ghost of a long dead serial killer. Soon, the friends and their partners are hunted down by the evil specter. Who will survive? Who will join the ghost in death? A supernatural slasher from Facemelt Features.

results.title: December 2024
results.overview: Fragments of a trans woman's life shortly before winter.

results.title: Budh Singh
results.overview: N the heart of rural Punjab, Budh Singh follows the life of a middle-class tehsil clerk struggling to uphold the values instilled by his father while battling financial pressure and moral temptation.

results.title: Resider
results.overview: When something goes bump in the night Adam fears he may not be alone in his new apartment. Whatever is residing within his walls, it seems to want out.

results.title: Ownerships
results.overview: Vera and Lucas, a frustrated couple in their forties, find a huge apartment at half the usual price thanks to a “bare ownership” deal: they buy it now, but the elderly owner will keep living there until he dies. What seemed like a miraculous opportunity soon turns into an obsession when Jesús disappears, reappears changed, and stops behaving like someone on his last legs. Caught between suspicion, frustration, and increasingly dark humor, the couple begins to consider a plan as absurd as it is tempting.

results.title: The General
results.overview: Zlatibor, at the end of the summer of 1943. British General Charles Armstrong, the new head of allied military missions, is coming to the Supreme Command of the Yugoslav Army. He announces the imminent capitulation of Italy and the landing of the Western Allies on the Adriatic Sea.

results.title: The Ultimate Planet
results.overview: After an accident, memories of his service on the Ninth Planet flash in the mind of auto mechanic Dima Khrust: amazing landscapes, the base of earthlings, battles with monsters, friends and his beloved girl Polina, whom he once saved... Khrust's colleagues twist their fingers at their temples, because theirs is completely different - ordinary army memories. But when Dima meets Polina in real life, he no longer doubts: someone corrected their memories. Who and why? The truth can only be found out by returning to the dangerous planet.

results.title: Our Dead Husband
results.overview: Graphic design firm owner Kris is devastated when she discovers her husband, Ritchie, shot dead in their home. She assumes it has to do with Ritchie's work in high-level intelligence. But as Kris prepares for the funeral, she learns that Ritchie's stories about his missions were a cover for a secret family a few hours away. When police begin to suspect Kris for the murder and an attempt is made on her life, she must overcome her distrust of Ritchie's other wife to find out who killed him—and who is now trying to kill her.
